# Kingdom Tinting LLC

> Window tinting service in Las Vegas, Nevada. Mobile tint installs in driveways, garages and work lots across the Las Vegas valley, plus a shop at 3340 Sunrise Ave #101, Las Vegas, NV 89101. Phone (702) 478-5977. Open Monday to Friday, 9 AM to 5 PM. Rated 5.0 from 30 Google reviews.

## Services
- Ceramic and nano-ceramic car and truck window tint
- Sunroof and moonroof tint, windshield sun strips
- Residential window tint (solar film)
- Commercial window tint
- Safety and security window film
- Decorative and frosted privacy film
- Anti-graffiti film
- Clearshield paint protection film

## Areas served
Las Vegas, Henderson, North Las Vegas, Summerlin, Spring Valley, Enterprise, Paradise, Boulder City

## Facts
- All films block 99% of UV rays and carry a manufacturer's limited warranty.
- Nevada law: front side windows must let in at least 35% of light; back side and rear windows can be any darkness.
- Free quotes by phone or text at (702) 478-5977.
